name: Thierry Dubois
bio:
Thierry's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood visits to the Spa-Francorchamps circuit with his father, a retired mechanic. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering at the University of Liège, specializing in vehicle dynamics and simulation. Eager to apply his theoretical knowledge to real-world racing, Thierry interned with a local GT team, where he gained valuable experience in data analysis and performance optimization. He believes in a data-driven approach, constantly seeking marginal gains through meticulous analysis and innovative solutions. 

Thierry is particularly interested in exploring novel aerodynamic concepts and suspension setups. He is an advocate for using advanced simulation tools to predict performance and identify potential issues before they arise on the track. Although still relatively new to the field, Thierry's enthusiasm and sharp analytical skills make him a promising addition to any team.
